---
title: "Decision records"
subtitle: "Every architectural decision, numbered, dated and immutable"
---

Recueil records its architectural decisions as numbered ADRs so that the reasoning stays readable in
order rather than being reconstructed from a diff two years later. Each record states its **context**
before its **decision**, and closes with **consequences** — including what the decision costs. An ADR
with no cost in it has not been thought through.

**An accepted ADR is never edited.** It is superseded by a later one and both stay in the
repository. Setting an earlier record's status to `Superseded by ADR-NNNN` is the only edit ever
made to an accepted record.

The records themselves live in
[`spec/adr/`](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/) in the repository.
This page is an index; the files are authoritative.

ADRs 0001–0012 are the technology decisions catalogued in
[CONCEPT.md §5.16](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/CONCEPT.md). ADRs
0013–0020 resolve the open-decision backlog in §10 — the questions the concept document deliberately
left open until they blocked something.

## Reading them in groups

Twenty records is more than anyone wants to read in order. These are the useful clusters.

**What the thing is.** [0001](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0001-server-first-architecture.md)
server-first, [0019](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0019-name-recueil.md)
the name, [0014](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0014-tool-for-you-through-m3-open-repo-at-m4.md)
who it is for and when that changes.

**How data is stored.** [0004](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0004-content-hash-identity.md)
content-hash identity, [0003](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0003-sqlite-by-default-postgres-optional.md)
and [0015](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0015-sqlite-only-until-multi-user.md)
the database, [0009](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0009-annotations-as-records-w3c-web-annotation-model.md)
and [0017](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0017-w3c-web-annotation-json-as-annotation-storage-format.md)
annotations, [0016](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0016-better-bibtex-compatible-citation-keys.md)
citation keys.

**How data gets out.** [0008](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0008-parquet-and-duckdb-analytics-layer.md)
the analytics layer, [0013](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0013-curation-canvas-in-app-ggraph-for-publication-figures.md)
publication figures.

**How it is extended.** [0012](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0012-in-process-trusted-plugin-host-in-v1.md)
and [0018](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0018-sandboxing-tier-in-process-until-multi-user.md)
the plugin host and its sandboxing tier, [0006](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0006-zotero-connector-protocol-compatibility.md)
the Zotero protocol.

**Ethics and disclosure.** [0005](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0005-agpl-30-or-later.md)
the licence, [0020](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/0020-systematic-review-automation-disclosure.md)
automation disclosure in systematic reviews.

## When a change needs an ADR

Write one if the change:

- adds, replaces or removes a dependency that would be painful to swap later — a database, a queue,
  a search engine, a UI framework;
- changes a public contract: the REST API's shape, the plugin API, the manifest schema, the storage
  layout, an export format;
- changes a stored data format, or requires a migration that cannot be reversed;
- trades away one of the binding principles, or narrows a stated goal;
- resolves a question already listed as open.

You do not need one for a bug fix, a refactor with no external effect, a first-party plugin that
uses only catalogued hooks, or documentation.

## Writing one

Take the next free number — four digits, never reused, even if a record is withdrawn — and name the
file `NNNN-kebab-case-title.md`. Copy the section structure of any existing record. Add a row to the
index table in [`spec/adr/README.md`](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-recueil/blob/main/spec/adr/README.md).

Propose it as a pull request containing **only the ADR**, with status `Proposed`, so that the
discussion happens on the decision rather than on the diff that implements it.

Statuses are `Proposed`, `Accepted`, `Superseded by ADR-NNNN` and `Deprecated`.
